answer: A commit-reveal deposit gate stops Sybil identities by making every new key post a bond that is locked until it proves independent work, such as a solved puzzle over a wide tundra of search space that no single machine can shortcut. Because the bond is charged per identity, a ripple of ten thousand clones means ten thousand locked deposits the attacker must fund up front, and any frozen or slashed relic of identity is lost with the rest.
